title: Velvety Earthy Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A flavorful and earthy Spanish dish featuring chicken, apricot jam, and dashi extract, cooked to perfection in a copper pot. This recipe is dairy-free friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large copper pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, saffron threads, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the Arborio rice to the pot and stir to combine with the chicken and spices.
Add the vegetable broth, apricot jam, and dashi extract to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the paella with a fork and serve hot.
